description: A compact list of metrics and their change over a period: one row per TrendItem, rendered as a semantic <ul> (the default) or as a table with real column headers. The delta is formatted with the culture's own percent convention, and the direction travels as an arrow icon, a tone class and a visually hidden word — colour is never the only carrier. Optional sparklines, per-row links, an empty state and a loading state complete the component.

parameters.name: Items
parameters.description: The metrics rendered, in the order the host supplied them (a trend is often chronological — the component never re-sorts). Null entries are skipped. Each TrendItem carries Id, Label, Value or NumericValue, Delta, PositiveIsGood, Sparkline and Href.

parameters.name: IsLoading
parameters.description: Renders the loading placeholder: skeletons plus a visually hidden localized "Loading values" text, with aria-busy="true" on the root. No stale row stays on screen.

parameters.name: Layout
parameters.description: How the rows present: List (the default semantic <ul>) or Table (a real <table> with localized column headers, a caption and a row header per metric).

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: An optional heading above the rows. It also NAMES the list through aria-labelledby (or the table's caption), so a reader hears what the rows are.

parameters.name: AriaLabel
parameters.description: The accessible name used when no Title is rendered. Null means the localized default ("Trend list").

parameters.name: DeltaFormat
parameters.description: An explicit .NET numeric format string for a row's Delta. Null (the default) uses the culture's own percent convention (English +12.5%, Czech +12,5 %). A malformed format falls back to that convention instead of throwing out of a render.

parameters.name: ValueFormat
parameters.description: The .NET numeric format string of a row's NumericValue (default N0 — whole, group-separated numbers). A string Value is host-formatted and rendered verbatim.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: The culture that formats the values and deltas. Null (the default) means the current culture at render time.

parameters.name: LabelHeader
parameters.description: Overrides the "Item" column header in the table layout. Null uses the localized default.

parameters.name: ValueHeader
parameters.description: Overrides the "Value" column header in the table layout. Null uses the localized default.

parameters.name: ChangeHeader
parameters.description: Overrides the "Change" column header in the table layout. Null uses the localized default.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class(es) for the root element.

parameters.name: DataTestId
parameters.description: Overrides the root data-testid; the default id is trend-list and TestIdPrefix namespaces it.

parameters.name: TestIdPrefix
parameters.description: Namespaces every internal data-testid of this instance as "{prefix}-{name}", so several lists on one page stay targetable.

examples.title: Metrics with their change over the period
A row that links to its report
examples.code:
<TmTrendList Items="@rows" />
@code {
    private readonly TrendItem[] rows =
    [
        new() { Id = "revenue", Label = "Revenue", NumericValue = 12450, Delta = 12.5, Href = "reports/revenue" }
    ];
}
